sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Beacon State Fork Upgrade
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition from Capella to Deneb BeaconState at the fork epoch boundary

nodes.label: Capella Beacon State
nodes.description: Beacon state in Capella format at the slot immediately before the Deneb fork epoch

nodes.label: Detect Deneb Fork Epoch
nodes.description: System detects that the current epoch equals DENEB_FORK_EPOCH (269568) and triggers the upgrade

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_deneb
nodes.description: Apply the upgrade_to_deneb function: copy all Capella fields, update fork version, add blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas (both initialized to 0) to ExecutionPayloadHeader

nodes.label: Deneb Beacon State
nodes.description: Beacon state now in Deneb format with new blob gas fields in execution payload header

nodes.label: Fork Metadata Updated
nodes.description: Fork object updated with current_version set to DENEB_FORK_VERSION and previous_version preserved

edges.label: State upgrade complete with blob gas fields

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob Gas Field Initialization
sub_graphs.description: Models the initialization of EIP-4844 blob gas accounting fields during the Deneb fork upgrade

nodes.label: No Blob Gas Fields (Capella)
nodes.description: ExecutionPayloadHeader in Capella format lacks blob gas fields

nodes.label: Initialize blob_gas_used to 0
nodes.description: Add blob_gas_used field to ExecutionPayloadHeader initialized to uint64(0)

nodes.label: Initialize excess_blob_gas to 0
nodes.description: Add excess_blob_gas field to ExecutionPayloadHeader initialized to uint64(0)

nodes.label: Blob Gas Accounting Active
nodes.description: ExecutionPayloadHeader now tracks blob gas usage and excess for EIP-4844 fee market

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Fork Transition Integrity Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints ensuring state integrity is preserved during the Capella-to-Deneb upgrade

nodes.label: Pre-Upgrade Capella State
nodes.description: Complete Capella beacon state with all fields populated

nodes.label: Verify All Capella Fields Preserved
nodes.description: Ensure all existing fields (genesis, validators, balances, participation, sync committees, etc.) are copied without modification

nodes.label: Verify Fork Version Chain
nodes.description: Ensure previous_version points to CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION and current_version is DENEB_FORK_VERSION with correct epoch

nodes.label: Upgrade Validated
nodes.description: State upgrade has been verified to maintain integrity of all pre-existing data

ambiguities.text: The specification is described as 'not definitive' configuration, leaving uncertainty about final parameter values
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the published values (epoch 269568, fork version 0x04000000) are final for mainnet. This assumption is based on the fork having already activated.

ambiguities.text: No explicit description of what happens if a node misses the fork epoch and needs to catch up
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes syncing past the fork epoch apply the upgrade function at the correct slot during sync. This is an assumption based on general fork handling patterns.

implicit_assumptions.description: All validators and nodes upgrade their software before DENEB_FORK_EPOCH to support the new state format
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes running Capella-only software would fail to process blocks after the fork, causing network partition.

implicit_assumptions.description: Initializing blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas to 0 is safe and does not create exploitable initial conditions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the initial zero values interact unexpectedly with the blob gas fee market formula, the first post-fork blocks could have incorrect blob gas pricing.
